## About
Apex Transmission & Automotive is a family-owned and operated transmission repair and replacement shop. We serve drivers in Apex, Cary, Holly Springs, Fuquay-Varina, Raleigh and throughout the Triangle.
Our goal is simple: top quality parts, good customer service and competitive prices. We try to educate our customers so they can make the right decisions about their vehicle, and our mechanics will always give it to you straight.
Transmissions are our specialty, but we're also a full service auto repair center. Customers often mention Ryan and Katie by name, and we're rated 4.8 from 296 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transmission Repair: If your transmission needs a couple of new parts, we can install the components and get you back on the road.
- Transmission Replacement: When a transmission has sustained extensive damage, we can perform a total transmission replacement.
- Transmission Maintenance: Regular maintenance on your transmission can help your vehicle live a longer life.
- Auto Repair: We're a full service auto repair center, so you don't have to pay dealer prices for quality work.
- Standard maintenance: Bringing your vehicle in for regular service keeps your engine working smoothly and your car running as long as possible.
- 24 Hour Emergency Towing: Towing is available around the clock. You must call for an appointment at 919-830-8626.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Apex and we serve Raleigh, Cary, Holly Springs and Fuquay-Varina.

Q: Do you only work on transmissions?
A: No. Transmissions are our specialty, but we're also a full service auto repair center and handle standard maintenance too.

Q: Can you replace a badly damaged transmission?
A: Yes. If your vehicle has sustained extensive damage, we can perform full transmission replacement service.
